evidences.description: Vauban Prime has access to a variety of damaging abilities including Tesla Nervos, Minelayer, Photon Strike, and Bastille.
The ability to capture enemies in stasis with Bastille provides an additional layer of damage through the stripping of their armor.

scores.reasoning: Vauban Prime has multiple high-damage options and can enhance its effectiveness by capturing enemies in stasis.

evidences.description: Vauban Prime's shield is equal to its health, providing moderate survivability.
The ability to capture enemies in stasis with Bastille can be used defensively to protect allies and remove threats.

scores.reasoning: While Vauban Prime has decent survivability due to its balanced health and shield, it lacks specific defensive abilities that could significantly improve this score.

evidences.description: Vauban Prime can immobilize enemies with Minelayer.
The ability to capture enemies in stasis with Bastille provides a strong support role by removing threats and enhancing allies' effectiveness.

scores.reasoning: Vauban Prime excels as a support character due to its ability to control the battlefield and enhance allies through stasis.

evidences.description: Bastille can capture enemies in stasis, effectively removing them from combat.

scores.reasoning: Vauban Prime has effective crowd control options through its ability to immobilize and stasis enemies.

evidences.description: Vauban Prime does not have any stealth-related abilities.
The Minelayer requires line of sight to deploy mines.

scores.reasoning: Vauban Prime lacks any stealth capabilities, making it less effective in covert operations.

evidences.description: Vauban Prime has a relatively straightforward set of abilities.
The Minelayer requires precise aiming to deploy mines effectively.

scores.reasoning: While Vauban Prime is not extremely complex, it does require some skill to use its abilities effectively.

data.summary: Vauban Prime excels as a support character due to its crowd control and ability to capture enemies in stasis. It has decent survivability and damage output but lacks stealth capabilities and complexity.
